title: Slay My Stats
description:
Uploads each run to [url=https://slay-my-stats.com]slay-my-stats.com[/url] when it ends, so you don't have to sign in and pick your history folder.

[h2]What it sends[/h2]
Your Steam ID, a short-lived Steam ticket that says this Steam account is playing, and each run as the game saves it, with a log of each fight. Runs you played unmodded before installing it are sent too.

[h2]Choosing what uploads[/h2]
By default every run from every profile uploads exactly as the game saved it. A co-op run file already contains your partners' Steam IDs, so they upload too, and the site uses them to link a co-op run to each player's copy. A small settings file lets you pause uploads, upload only some profiles, or blank your partners' IDs. How to find and edit it is in the [url=https://github.com/johnstonjesse329/slay-my-stats-mod#choosing-what-uploads]README[/url].

[h2]Your saves[/h2]
With any mod loaded, the game keeps its saves in a separate "modded" folder, and it starts empty. So that you don't have to replay ascensions or unlock everything again, Slay My Stats lifts each modded profile to your normal profile in the same slot. Each character's highest ascension, any wins and losses the modded profile doesn't have yet, and your unlocks all carry over. It only ever raises things, and it never changes your normal saves.

Before it changes a modded profile, it saves a dated copy of that profile's progress file in %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\SlayMyStats\backups\modded-profileN\, and it never deletes any of your files. To turn this off, create %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\SlayMyStats\config.json containing {"carry_progress": false}. How to restore a backup is in the [url=https://github.com/johnstonjesse329/slay-my-stats-mod]README[/url]. Unsubscribe and the game goes back to your normal saves.

[h2]Turning it off[/h2]
Switch it off in the game's mod list, or unsubscribe.

Source: [url=https://github.com/johnstonjesse329/slay-my-stats-mod]github.com/johnstonjesse329/slay-my-stats-mod[/url]
changeNote: 0.0.3: New settings file for choosing what uploads. In %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\SlayMyStats\config.json (the mod creates it) you can pause uploads, upload only some profiles, and blank your co-op partners' Steam IDs before a run is sent. If the file has a mistake, nothing uploads, the main menu says so, and a note beside the file gives the exact error. Steps and details: https://github.com/johnstonjesse329/slay-my-stats-mod#choosing-what-uploads
